authority_boundaries.pre_write: one fresh complete inventory for locks and lock_removals
authority_boundaries.write: create-only write followed by exact-object read-back
authority_boundaries.post_write: separate fresh complete inventory for locks and lock_removals
authority_boundaries.publication_retry: fresh membership reconciliation with no lock write

verified_invariants: active state excludes tombstoned lock hashes
changed re-lock generation invalidates the prior review token
conditional-write loser is not reported as the winning lock
partial batches report exact verified and unresolved keys
timed-out committed writes are resolved only by exact read-back
post-write and retry phases do not reuse pre-write membership
bounded worker sessions remain isolated and closed
